name: Windows Repeated Failed Authentication
description: Detects multiple failed logon attempts (EventID 4625) from a single host or source IP within a short time window.
false_positive_guidance: Misconfigured applications or service accounts with expired passwords attempting automated reconnections.

name: Windows Successful Authentication Following Failures
description: Detects a successful login (EventID 4624) immediately following repeated failed authentication attempts, indicating possible password guessing or brute-force success.
false_positive_guidance: Legitimate user who mistyped their password several times before correctly entering it.

name: Suspicious PowerShell Execution
description: Detects PowerShell execution with suspicious command-line flags, encoded commands, or download cradles.
false_positive_guidance: Legitimate administrative deployment scripts utilizing encoded parameters.

name: Suspicious Process Creation
description: Detects execution of sensitive administrative tools, credential dumping utilities, or web shells.
false_positive_guidance: Authorized system administrators performing system maintenance or security audits.

name: Linux Repeated SSH Authentication Failures
description: Detects multiple failed SSH authentication attempts on Linux hosts within a short time window.
false_positive_guidance: Automated SSH connection attempts from internal monitoring tools with stale credentials.

name: Linux Successful SSH Login Following Failures
description: Detects a successful SSH authentication following repeated SSH authentication failures.
false_positive_guidance: Analyst logging into SSH after several typos.

name: Suspicious Sudo Elevation Activity
description: Detects privileged command execution via sudo or privilege escalation attempts on Linux.
false_positive_guidance: Authorized administrators executing routine system maintenance commands.

name: Suspicious DNS Tunneling Activity
description: Detects high-frequency or high-entropy DNS queries indicative of C2 data exfiltration or tunneling.
false_positive_guidance: Internal domain resolution tools generating high volumes of subdomains.

name: Network IDS Alert Ingestion
description: Detects high-severity signatures triggered by Suricata or Zeek Network Detection Sensors.
